title: medeval-lab benchmark item
description: A single evaluation item. Version v0.1. Items must carry complete provenance, a label source and a licence; the Python validator applies additional semantic checks that JSON Schema cannot express (gold answer present in options, DOI rules per label_source, duplicate ids).

text.description: The clinical stem, written in original wording.

options.description: Answer options without letter prefixes. Empty array means an open-ended item scored by rubric, not by exact match.

gold_answer.description: For multiple-choice items: verbatim text of the correct option. For open items: the reference answer text.

publication_date.description: Date of the source publication, or item-creation date for synthetic items.

human_reference.description: Reserved for later clinician labels. Must be null in v0.1 (no clinician workflow exists yet).

notes.description: Free text. For planted_error items this must describe the planted error.

doi.description: DOI of the source publication. Null for synthetic items only.

section.description: Section/table/figure of the source used for the fact.

licence.description: Source licence (SPDX identifier where possible) or 'synthetic-original'.

labels.description: Per-rater labels keyed by rater id.

rater_ids.description: Identifiers of human raters. Fewer than two raters cannot support agreement statistics.
